### [`final_stage_attack`](../../../../src/story/final_stage.asm#L6) `$84B6`

*routine*

Final stage: starts the bolt of Drax (sprite 4) at the right on path $8a or $8b (random). When it reaches fighter 0, checks the move of fighter 0.

<a id="check_attack_contact"></a>
### [`check_attack_contact`](../../../../src/story/final_stage.asm#L62) `$851B`

*routine*

Sprite 4 is at fighter 0. If fighter 0 does a move of the list for this path, sprite 4 stops. Else fighter 0 dies and the game ends.

- **Called from:** [`final_stage_attack`](final_stage.md#final_stage_attack)

<a id="update_fighters_frame"></a>
### [`update_fighters_frame`](../../../../src/story/final_stage.asm#L174) `$85F0`

*routine*

Updates and draws both fighters for one frame. It does not call set_fighter_poses as the main loop does, so fighter_pose does not change in the end loops.

- **Called from:** [`end_bout`](../combat/end_of_bout.md#end_bout), [`check_attack_contact`](final_stage.md#check_attack_contact), [`check_final_goal`](final_stage.md#check_final_goal)
